panels.description: At-a-glance activity, reliability, latency, and correction quality for the selected videos and time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')) IN (
  SELECT tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key'))
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
    AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
) AS is_sam2_prediction
SELECT
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Inferred frames",
  round(countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking'), 0), 1) AS "Success rate",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'), 1) AS "Client request P95",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server per-frame P95",
  round(uniqExactIf(tuple(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')), scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'), 0), 1) AS "Correction rate"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))

panels.title: Overview

panels.description: Client values measure the complete batched request. Server values are normalized per frame.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(duration), 1) AS "Client request P50",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration), 1) AS "Client request P95",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server per-frame P50",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server per-frame P95"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Inference latency

panels.description: Completed tracking runs split by outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS Successful,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'failed') AS Failed
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_tracking'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))

panels.title: Run outcomes

panels.description: Stacked median server phases per frame. Bars avoid implying continuous latency between sparse inference samples.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'decode_ms')), 1) AS "Image decode",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'preprocess_cpu_ms')), 1) AS "Preprocess CPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'state_load_ms')), 1) AS "State load",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'encoder_gpu_ms')), 1) AS "Encoder GPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms')), 1) AS "Tracker GPU",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(greatest(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_wall_ms') - JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms'), 0)), 1) AS "Tracker CPU and postprocess",
  round(quantileTDigest(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'state_save_ms')), 1) AS "State save"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'encoder_gpu_ms')
  AND JSONHas(payload, 'tracker_gpu_ms')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Server phase mix (P50 per frame)

panels.description: How much temporal history the tracker used, how often the server session was reused, and how often a correction reset tracking state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(avgOrNullIf(least(greatest(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'context_frames') - 1, 0), 6), JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'context_frames')), 1) AS "Average history frames",
  round(countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'session_reused') AND JSONExtractBool(payload, 'session_reused')) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'session_reused')), 0), 1) AS "Session reuse",
  countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'correct') AS "Correction resets"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))

panels.title: Tracking context

panels.description: Compact comparison across the selected videos.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')) IN (
  SELECT tuple(task_id, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key'))
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
    AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
) AS is_sam2_prediction
SELECT
  concat(anyIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name'), JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name') != ''), ' (#', toString(task_id), ')') AS Video,
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS "Successful runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'failed') AS "Failed runs",
  countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS "Inferred frames",
  round(uniqExactIf(tuple(JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame'), JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_key')), scope = 'edit:mask' AND is_sam2_prediction) * 100.0 / nullIf("Inferred frames", 0), 1) AS "Correction rate",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(duration, scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'), 1) AS "Client request P95",
  round(quantileTDigestIf(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track' AND JSONHas(payload, 'server_total_ms')), 1) AS "Server per-frame P95"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask')
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
GROUP BY task_id
HAVING "Inferred frames" > 0 OR "Successful runs" > 0 OR "Failed runs" > 0
ORDER BY "Inferred frames" DESC

panels.title: Per-video details

panels.description: The 25 slowest client requests, with batch size and normalized server time to distinguish network or UI delay from inference time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS Time,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name') AS Video,
  JSONExtractInt(payload, 'frame') AS Frame,
  JSONExtractString(payload, 'direction') AS Direction,
  JSONExtractInt(payload, 'object_count') AS Objects,
  JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'batch_size') AS Batch,
  duration AS "Client request",
  JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'server_total_ms') AS "Server per frame"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope = 'run:sam2_inference'
  AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track'
  AND (-1 IN (${videos}) OR task_id IN (${videos}))
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Slowest requests

list.definition:
SELECT
  task_id AS __value,
  concat(any(JSONExtractString(payload, 'video_name')), ' (#', toString(task_id), ')') AS __text
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND scope IN ('run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference', 'edit:mask', 'confirm:mask')
  AND task_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY __text
